title: A Note on the Essay
story: Andre expected a marked essay on his desk, but he found only a short note from his tutor. She wanted him to clarify two claims and resubmit the work by Monday. The note also said his examples were relevant, so the delay was about precision rather than the topic. He booked a brief meeting and started a list of the sentences he would rewrite.

vocabulary.definition: Read by a teacher and given a result or comments.
Make an idea clearer and easier to understand.
Hand a piece of work in again.
Connected in a useful way to the subject.
Write something again in order to improve it.

quiz.question: When did the tutor want the work handed in again?
options: By Monday
The same afternoon
After the long holiday
Only if the meeting was cancelled
quiz.explanation: She asked him to resubmit the work by Monday.
quiz.supportingSentence: She wanted him to clarify two claims and resubmit the work by Monday.

quiz.question: What does a note, instead of a marked essay, suggest?
options: The essay was not ready for a final mark
The tutor had lost the essay
Andre had already rewritten every line
The desk belonged to another student
quiz.correctAnswer: The essay was not ready for a final mark
quiz.explanation: He expected a marked essay and found only a note, so the work had not been finally graded.
quiz.supportingSentence: Andre expected a marked essay on his desk, but he found only a short note from his tutor.

quiz.question: What does Andre’s list suggest about his plan?
options: He will change parts of this essay rather than start a new one
He will skip the meeting with his tutor
He will throw the note away unread
He will give the essay a mark himself
quiz.correctAnswer: He will change parts of this essay rather than start a new one
quiz.explanation: A list of sentences to rewrite shows he is revising this essay, not abandoning it.
quiz.supportingSentence: He booked a brief meeting and started a list of the sentences he would rewrite.

quiz.question: What does clarify mean in this story?
options: Make something clearer
Hand work in for the first time
Book a long meeting
Give a piece of work a mark
quiz.explanation: The tutor asked him to clarify two claims, meaning those points needed to be clearer.
quiz.supportingSentence: She wanted him to clarify two claims and resubmit the work by Monday.

quiz.question: What is the tutor’s aim in asking for the work again?
options: She wants the two claims to be clearer
She wants him to choose a new topic
She wants the examples removed
She wants the meeting to replace the essay
quiz.correctAnswer: She wants the two claims to be clearer
quiz.explanation: She asked him to clarify two claims and then resubmit the essay.
quiz.supportingSentence: She wanted him to clarify two claims and resubmit the work by Monday.
